catalogue.name: HG - Hobgoblins
catalogue.readme:
The Citadels of the Infernal Dwarves have only one master, and a lowly hobgoblin can only rise so far under the weight of laws enforced with fire, chain and whip. Yet Infernal dominion extends beyond the walls of the Masters, and in lands held under vassalage to the great Citadels, even a servant may wield power.

Adopting and adapting the ways of their overlords, hobgoblins have become more than cringing lackeys or mere slaves, establishing a strength which is of their own making. Their greatest advantages are the wisdom to bend rather than break, and the cunning to turn that flexibility into a weapon. Big, scary pets don’t hurt either.
